title: OM SecurityAdvisory logical schema
description: Signed vulnerability advisory (ADR-0104). An input selected by subscribers; never remote-disable or protocol authority. Floors are split into own_release_floor (own clients) and peer_floor (peer-affecting, root-threshold governed) by ADR-0130; the former recommended_floor object is replaced.

issuer_key_ref.description: Issuer signing key: for a distribution, the advisory role delegated from its TUF root (ADR-0130 rule 3); issuer is a distribution, steward lineage or researcher, never a protocol authority.

expires_at.description: Wall-clock expiry (seconds). After it, the advisory's floors are no longer newly applied. Mandatory (ADR-0130 rule 3).

own_release_floor.description: Minimum release version for the issuing distribution's own clients only; signed by the delegated advisory key (ADR-0130 rule 3).

peer_floor.description: Minimum CryptoProfile/protocol generation a subscriber MAY adopt as its own peer-local floor (R-170). Applied automatically only with root-threshold signatures; may name only a registry-preferred profile/generation with at least two independent implementations; user override permitted unless threshold-signed (ADR-0130 rule 3).

root_threshold_signatures.description: signatures by the issuing distribution's root keys meeting its root threshold
